description: Create copy-paste CSS loading spinners: ring, dots, bars and dual-ring styles with your size and color, with a live preview.

faqs.a: Yes. The output is a single <div> plus a <style> block with pure CSS — no JavaScript or images needed.
faqs.q: Does the spinner need JavaScript to animate?

faqs.a: The snippet is self-contained, so paste it into any page and the spinner will animate wherever you place the div.
faqs.q: Can I use multiple spinners on one page?

faqs.a: Only if your project uses CSS-in-JS. The generated code is plain CSS and works best in a <style> tag or stylesheet.
faqs.q: Does it work in React or Tailwind projects?

howto: Pick a spinner style (ring, dots, bars, dual-ring).
Adjust the size, color and animation speed.
Preview the spinner live on the page.
Click "Copy HTML + CSS" and paste the snippet where you need a loader.
